**Quick Garlic Shrimp Pasta (≈15 min)**  
*Ingredients*: 8 oz spaghetti, 12 oz peeled shrimp, 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 cloves garlic (minced), ½ tsp red‑pepper flakes, zest & juice of 1 lemon, ¼ cup chopped parsley, salt & pepper, grated Parmesan (optional).  
*Steps*: 1️⃣ Cook pasta al dente, reserve ½ cup water. 2️⃣ While pasta cooks, heat oil in a skillet over medium‑high; add garlic & red‑pepper flakes, sauté 30 s. 3️⃣ Add shrimp, season, cook 2 min per side until pink. 4️⃣ Toss pasta, lemon zest/juice, parsley, and reserved water into skillet; mix 1 min. 5️⃣ Serve with Parmesan if desired.
